muu.A: Same soft hand-painted storybook style, same round gold-rimmed medallion and same chibi proportions as the reference, but the person is now a young CONSORT (imperial concubine) of the inner palace, a graceful woman about twenty-two with a soft pretty face, black hair in a neat elegant bun with two gold hairpins, a small pearl hair ornament and one small pink flower (no crown, no phoenix), a jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with an ivory (#F1E6D2) collar and light gold embroidery at the shoulders.
